hard_requirements: The provider response validates against the exact strict wire schema before local defaults are applied.
The review passes candidate, changed-path, and evidence-reference semantic validation.
The review makes no policy, admission, mutation, or lifecycle decision.
The evidence bundle, invocation record, and result manifest are content-addressed and linked.
No critical or high-severity finding is accepted unless it is directly supported by supplied evidence.

quality_themes.description: The patch adds a real centralized RuntimeInspection invariant: completed status requires completion data.
A downstream campaign guard already rejected the inconsistent completed state, so the improvement is valuable but its practical impact is bounded.
The added public test covers the invalid state but does not directly cover the valid completed-plus-completion state and representative non-completed states.
The generated JSON Schema cannot express this cross-field model invariant, so schema-only consumers remain more permissive than Pydantic validation.

quality_pass_rule: At least two distinct quality themes must be substantively present in the review, including at least one limitation or test-gap theme.
